title: Batuque
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Skateboarding teen Ichiri Sanjou chafes under her strict parents until a homeless-looking Brazilian man drags her into a convenience store robbery and then teaches her and her friends capoeira. She learns she was adopted and is the daughter of the boss of a Brazilian crime syndicate, Lança Mortal, and is pulled into a violent 'Inheritance War' among his children. An 18-volume martial-arts coming-of-age story.
life_message: Freedom and joy are found by claiming your own body and voice, while still standing by the family that raised you.
